text:
Liam (Sales): Hi team — Acme Health is asking for a timeboxed SOC 2 evidence snapshot for a short POC. They need sample logs, a couple of system config screenshots, and confirmation of encryption/KMS. They want 7 days of access. Can we do a presigned link + a bridge-letter instead of sending the full report? @Priya @Noor
Sam (SE): We can export a limited evidence bundle: app logs (last 30 days filtered), ingress/egress network diagrams (redacted), and screenshots of console settings. No secrets, no raw DB dumps.
Priya (Legal): OK in principle. We need an NDA signed + a scoped bridge letter that explicitly says this is a snapshot for evaluation only, not the SOC 2 report itself. Also require a recipient list and that they won't redistribute.
Noor (Security): For the bundle: redact IPs and usernames, strip any API keys, and sanitize any PII. We'll mark what counts as "evidence" vs "operational data".
Liam (Sales): @Daniel can you confirm who at Acme will need access (names + emails) and whether they have a signed NDA? We can pause until we have that.
Daniel (Acme): I'll have legal sign the NDA today. Users: me (daniel@acmehealth.com), tanya@acmehealth.com, and eng-lead@acmehealth.com. 7-day access window is fine.
Alex (SalesOps): Once NDA is in place we can provision a presigned S3 URL and a short bridge-letter PDF. Template available in //redwood/legal/templates/bridge-snapshot-v2.pdf (internal).
DocBot (automation): NDA upload detected: https://redwood.internal/ndas/ACME-2005-signed.pdf (access controlled).
Priya (Legal): Received the NDA. I'll draft a scoped bridge letter that references the NDA, includes the recipient list, and notes permitted uses. Expect a draft in ~2 business hours.
Sam (SE): Prep checklist for bundle: 1) App logs filtered to error/trace levels only; 2) Redacted access logs (no IPs); 3) Config screenshots (auth, KMS, network settings); 4) Short README describing redactions and the limitation that this is not a full SOC 2 attestation.
Noor (Security): Add a hash manifest for each file and disable directory listing on the S3 bucket. We'll set the presigned links to expire after 7 days and disable copy/paste via object ACL? (can't fully prevent) — note to customer that it's a best-effort snapshot.
Liam (Sales): Good call — include the manifest and a one-paragraph caveat in the letter. @Priya please call out retention and that we won't re-run exports after link expiry unless a new request is made.
Priya (Legal): Draft ready and uploaded: https://redwood.internal/bridge-drafts/ACME-snapshot-draft-2005.pdf. Highlights: timeboxed access, recipients, non-distribution, no reliance on this snapshot for compliance. Please review.
Sam (SE): Review done. Small nit: add explicit line that api_key strings are redacted and that logs are sampled. Approved from eng side.
Noor (Security): Approved from security, added redaction checklist in the bundle README.
Liam (Sales): @Daniel we'll send the presigned URL and the signed bridge letter once you confirm the NDA signer and recipients. ETA for link: today EOD PST.
Daniel (Acme): Confirmed — NDA signer will be Tanya. Thanks everyone.
Alex (SalesOps): Presigned URL prepared: (will be posted after bridge is signed). Reminder: links expire at 2025-06-10T18:00:00Z (7 days).
Priya (Legal): Liam — after Daniel confirms Tanya signed, I'll countersign the bridge-letter and stamp it. Then SalesOps can post the link.
Liam (Sales): Thanks all. Small follow-up: pricing note for POC — if they request extended access or additional evidence we should map to our POC support add-on. @Alex can you follow up with Daniel if that becomes needed?
Alex (SalesOps): On it. I'll add a short note in the final message to Acme about how to request extended evidence (email salesops@redwood.com).
DocBot (automation): Bridge-letter signed and uploaded: https://redwood.internal/bridge-signed/ACME-bridge-2005.pdf
Alex (SalesOps): Presigned S3 link (private) posted to Acme recipients via secure message. DO NOT paste the URL in public channels.
Daniel (Acme): Received link and bridge — downloading now. Thanks everyone, appreciated quick turnaround.
Liam (Sales): Awesome. Closing loop: after download window closes, we'll delete the snapshot and update the manifest with deletion timestamp. I'll post a deletion confirmation here.
Noor (Security): Please ensure audit log entry is created for the object access and deletion event.
Liam (Sales): Will do. :thumbsup:
